title: APAAR ID: What It Is, Is It Mandatory and How to Create One via DigiLocker
seoTitle: APAAR ID: Is It Mandatory? How to Create It via DigiLocker
seoDescription: APAAR ID is a 12-digit student ID tied to ABC and DigiLocker. Is it mandatory? What CBSE and the SC now say, how to create it and fix Aadhaar mismatches.
excerpt: Why CBSE made APAAR optional for the 2027 boards, what the Supreme Court's opt-out directions mean for parents, how the ID doubles as your ABC credit account, and how to fix name or date-of-birth mismatches.
